mr_title: Move expensive operations outside of Analyzer/Identifier.h
mr_description:
- Move expensive operations outside of Analyzer/Identifier.h
- Reduce dependencies on Analyzer/Identifier.h
- Merge remote-tracking branch 'blessed/master' into identifier_h

expected_issues.title: The initializer list for `Identifier::Identifier` is excessively long on a single line
expected_issues.description: The initializer list for `Identifier::Identifier` is excessively long on a single line. Split it across multiple lines to improve readability and maintainability.
expected_issues.source_text: The initializer list for `Identifier::Identifier` is excessively long on a single line. Split it across multiple lines to improve readability and maintainability.

expected_issues.title: The Identifier constructor for full name strings fails to initialize the `parts` member v…
expected_issues.description: The Identifier constructor for full name strings fails to initialize the `parts` member variable, leaving it default-constructed as an empty vector despite the comment stating it should split the full name by '.' separators. This will cause incorrect behavior when parts are accessed.
expected_issues.source_text: The Identifier constructor for full name strings fails to initialize the `parts` member variable, leaving it default-constructed as an empty vector despite the comment stating it should split the full name by '.' separators. expected_issues.title: Consider simplifying this section using standard library facilities such as assigning sub…
expected_issues.description: Consider simplifying this section using standard library facilities such as assigning subranges directly instead of manually constructing result vector. E.g.: parts.assign(parts.begin() + parts_to_remove_size, parts.end()); followed by updating full_name accordingly.
expected_issues.source_text: Consider simplifying this section using standard library facilities such as assigning subranges directly instead of manually constructing result vector. E.g.: parts.assign(parts.begin() + parts_to_remove_size, parts.end()); followed by updating full_name accordingly.

expected_issues.title: The `IdentifierView::popLast` method incorrectly uses `assert` instead of `chassert`, con…
expected_issues.description:
The `IdentifierView::popLast` method incorrectly uses `assert` instead of `chassert`, contradicting the stated replacement rationale.  
Move all methods back to the header for inlining since `chassert` eliminates the need for `<cassert>` includes.
expected_issues.source_text:
The `IdentifierView::popLast` method incorrectly uses `assert` instead of `chassert`, contradicting the stated replacement rationale.  
Move all methods back to the header for inlining since `chassert` eliminates the need for `<cassert>` includes.
